# My Dream Coding Project: StuddyBuddy
## Project Overview
**StudyBuddy** is and app designed to help students plan their homework, track their study time, and stay motivated during tough weeks. It's built using **HTML, CSS,** and **Javascript** - but one day, I want to turn it into a full mobile app.

---
## Project Goals
- Build a simple dashbaord that tracks:
    - homework due dates
    - minutes studied each day
    - subjects that need extra practice 
- Show encouraging messages using: 
    - `console.log` to test my code
    
     ```
    if (minutesStudied >= 30) {
        console.log("Awesome work! You hit your gaol today!") ;
    } else{
        console.log("Keep going, every minute counts!");
   }
   ```
